title: Engaged couple, partner not on the call
scenario: First-time buyer engaged to be married wants to buy together but his fiancee is the higher earner and isn't on the call. He warms up and asks how to start.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Hi, is this Declan? This is Yusuf with Copperleaf Home Loans.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Hey, yeah. What's up, man.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Not much. I saw you were looking into buying your first home?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yeah, me and my fiancee. We're getting married in May and we're tired of paying rent.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Congrats! That's exciting. Would you both be on the loan?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yeah, definitely. Honestly she makes more than me, so I can't really go much further without her.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Makes sense. We can absolutely loop her in. Can I ask a few general questions in the meantime?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Sure, go for it.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Where are you two looking?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Out in the suburbs, closer to her parents. They're going to babysit someday, ha.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Smart planning. Do you know roughly what you've saved for a down payment?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Like thirty grand between us. Her parents might help too.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Okay, gift funds are pretty common. We'd just need a gift letter for those.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Oh, cool. So how do we actually get started on this?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: The first step is an application for both of you, then we review income and credit and go from there.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Okay. But yeah, she's going to want to be part of that. She's the spreadsheet person.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Totally. When could we get both of you on a call?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: She's off Fridays.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: How about Friday at one?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Friday at one works.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Great, I'll send an invite to you both. Talk Friday.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Sounds good, thanks man.
